description.value: A natural area park gifted to the City of Surrey, featuring towering trees and rich birdwatching opportunities in the Fleetwood neighbourhood. The preserve is managed for biodiversity and environmental sensitivity, with dogs and weddings prohibited to protect the habitat. A peaceful stop for touring cyclists looking to stretch their legs on a nature walk between rides.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a city-owned nature preserve park in Surrey's Fleetwood neighbourhood, gifted to the city, with towering trees and birdwatching opportunities. The website content was truncated right at the 'Features' section, so specific amenity details (bike racks, washrooms, water) could not be confirmed. No OSM tags provide amenity data either. Address on the website matches OSM; phone and email appear on the website but not in OSM tags.
concerns: Website content truncated at the 'Features' section — amenity details may exist but were not captured.
Phone (604-501-5050) and email (parks@surrey.ca) appear on the website but are not present in OSM tags — these are general City of Surrey parks contacts, not site-specific.
Winter parking lot access is limited to weekends and statutory holidays, which may affect cyclist access during colder months.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate city nature preserve and a plausible cycling attraction, but the website's Features section was truncated so none of the required criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) could be confirmed. Manual check of the full park page is needed.

wow_evidence: Quiet biodiversity preserve with big trees and birding — pleasant ordinary.
blurb: Biodiversity preserve of tall trees and birdlife in Fleetwood.
